prose.updateCadence: Developed in 1974, the Rural-Urban Continuum Codes have been updated each decade since (1983, 1993, 2003, 2013, 2023).
prose.coverage: 1974 to 2023, county-level data for the United States including outlying territories and Puerto Rico.
prose.geography: Each county and census-designated county-equivalent in the United States, including those in outlying territories, is assigned one of these nine codes.

accessNotes.text: Downloadable files for each decade of Rural-Urban Continuum Codes from 1974 to 2023 are provided in XLS, XLSX, and CSV formats.
